description: Unified shared base of Neuralese direct v1 for both lines (line parity, owner 2026-10-11; plans/neuralese/LINE_PARITY.md). Same stage as neuralese-direct-v1 with: (1) two phases of one lineage, as recipe stages: direct_warmup, 0.5 epoch of the root-adopted 4962-document text union with its full system prompts, then direct_sft, continuing from it (weights, projections, optimizer), 2 epochs of the same documents' program-header twin (generic system prompt dropped after the warm-up, owner 2026-10-11; NO_SYSTEM_PROMPT_RENDERING_DECOMPOSITION.md); whole-trajectory documents join as a later phase when registered (newest-data rule: a handoff). The CLI cannot substitute the data; a line whose tokenizer differs binds its registered tokenizer twins (same documents, ids, splits and source groups). (2) The budget is epochs, not steps (data audit 2026-10-11, DATA_INVENTORY_20261011.md E: the former 750 x 1024 = 768,000 'supervised positions' covered 0.11 epoch): an epoch is one pass over the target-bearing train windows (a window whose span holds decision-target tokens), sampled by document without replacement (the shared CohortDocumentSampler, text_supervision.epoch_schedule); context-only windows are not trained; direct_sft derives the update count from the data and the packing and reports epochs covered and supervised tokens per update. Equal supervision across lines is equal epochs over the same (twin) data. (3) Packing: each update holds windows up to batch_tokens forward tokens (count x longest, right-padded, length-bucketed in runs of 256; causal attention and convolutions keep real positions exact; padding carries no weight); batch_tokens is a fit-only per-line value (Mellum 32768: 333 updates for the warm-up, 346 for direct_sft on the current twins, ~23 s each at the fitted MuonSR cost). (4) Shared context capacity 32768 tokens (capacity 32768 - target_tokens, so every document keeps its whole preceding context); target_tokens is a per-line memory knob. (5) One monitor for both lines: Pop's 48 clean-base probes (12 each plain exact math, tool, open answer, natlang test turn) as the in-run captured drift reference (the base model's, kept across phases) and as the behaviour gate's probes, each line declaring its own measured base gate_pass. (6) Cadence keeping evaluation near 3% of wall time, set per line from the derived update count (fit-only): held eval and the gate at each phase end, full state at half way and the end, drift monitor every 110 updates, gate-at-warn at most every 220. (7) Optimizer and drift policy (coordinator decision 2026-10-11; OPTIMIZER_BAKEOFF_20261011.md): latents on MuonSR (Nesterov 0.95, cubic5 Newton-Schulz, 0.2 sqrt(max) scale, wd 0.1, idle experts skipped) at one shared latent_lr 3e-6; the behaviour gate (pass >= base - 0.1) is the hard criterion, response KL warns at 0.5 (runs the gate) and stops only at 1.5. (6) Gradient clipping (coordinator decision 2026-10-11): spike-only, an update whose global norm exceeds 5x the running median of the last 64 updates' norms is clipped to that threshold (grad_spike_clip 5.0; train/optim.py SpikeClip); a fixed clip of 1.0 was active on every update at our norms (17-915) and measured harmful. (8) Qualification (owner decision 2026-10-12, plans/neuralese/DECISIONS.md, supersedes the gate clause of (7)): the 48-probe behaviour gate is REPORT-ONLY (run at a warn and at the end, logged with gate_below_floor, never a stop or a qualification requirement); a stage qualifies on held CE below base, no drift stop (response KL 1.5) and the in-run task-success evaluation (task_eval, eval/task_cadence.py) over the registered held packet natlang-held-task-packet-v2-20261012 (64 natlang programs, 16 shapes): a 16-task cadence subset, one task per shape, executed for real by the TS collector against the model being trained, in the trainer's own process at every eval and at the end. Relative pass bar (coordinator 2026-10-12): the final evaluation is at least the line's base (reference_successes, declared per line; unmeasured fails) and not below the previous evaluation minus noise_successes (measured by repeat runs, declared per line).
